title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-18
source: Master Reels>Dat>Clone directly to me via snail mail>file cloned into Microtrack using Tascam Dat deck>Goldwave tracking and removal on one glitch (reel change)>TLH8

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a crisp mix but excessive banter and tuning between tracks; the show itself receives no strong praise or criticism.
ai_review.review: The mix is praised as clear and well‑balanced, yet the way each song was split into separate tracks leaves a lot of onstage chatter and endless tuning at the start of every cut, which many listeners find disruptive. No specific musical highlights are mentioned, so the performance is judged neutral overall, making this release more interesting for its authentic pacing than for any standout playing.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates it low (2 stars) due to tracking issues, while another enthusiastically praises the mix and authentic pacing; limited data yields a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is crisp and well‑balanced, but the track splitting captures excessive banter and tuning between songs, making listening less smooth.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Preserves the natural pacing of the concert with each > split into its own track, but the constant banter/tuning at each start can feel disjointed.
